Plot a chirp-matched EHA map, with or without the surrogate significance

Source: R/plot_chirp_eha.R
plot_chirp_eha.Rd

Two styles of "enhanced spectrum" for a analyse_chirp_eha result: "significance" shows the line-to-continuum ratio divided by the 95th percentile of the warped surrogates (Power_sig, from chirp_eha_significance; above 1, i.e. above 0 on the log scale, is significant), "outline" shows the de-chirped map itself (Power_norm) with the significant cells outlined, and "plain" the de-chirped map alone.

Usage

plot_chirp_eha(
  ce,
  style = c("outline", "significance", "plain"),
  track = NULL,
  show = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  palette = "viridis",
  main = NULL,
  xlab = "Depth",
  ylab = "Period",
  scale = "auto"
)

Arguments

ce

Chirp-matched EHA result to plot: the list returned by analyse_chirp_eha; for style = "outline" or "significance" it must first be passed through chirp_eha_significance (which adds Power_sig and Power_pval). Required, no default.

style

Plot style (character), one of:

  • "outline": the de-chirped map (Power_norm) with the cells significant at level outlined in white;

  • "significance": log10 of the ratio of the observed map to the 95th percentile of the warped surrogates (Power_sig), with a diverging blue-red scale centred on 0 (above 0 is significant);

  • "plain": the de-chirped map alone (no significance needed).

Default="outline" (the first element of c("outline", "significance", "plain")).

track

Sedimentation-rate track used to draw the expected periods of the astronomical cycles in show: a wr_track object or a track_astro_auto result (its track element is used), i.e. a list or data frame with depth and sedrate (depth units per kyr). Nothing is drawn when track or show is NULL. Default=NULL.

show

Astronomical periods in kyr (numeric vector, e.g. c(405, 100, 40, 20)) drawn as dotted lines at period = show times track$sedrate along the record; only used with track. Default=NULL.

level

Confidence level of the significance outline of style = "outline" (numeric, between 0 and 1): cells with surrogate p-value Power_pval <= 1 - level are outlined. Default=0.95.

palette

Name of a hcl.colors palette for the colour scale, a character string, for example "viridis", "Plasma", "Inferno", "YlOrRd", "Spectral", "Blue-Red", "Zissou 1"; run grDevices::hcl.pals() to list all 115 names. Low values get the first colour of the palette. Names of the viridis family ("viridis", "magma", "inferno", "plasma", "cividis", "rocket", "mako", "turbo") give the colours of the viridis package, as in the wavelet plots. Default="viridis".

main

Title of the plot (character); NULL gives a title that describes the chosen style. Default=NULL.

xlab

Label of the depth axis (character). Default="Depth".

ylab

Label of the period axis (character). Default="Period".

scale

Spacing of the colour breaks of the colour scale, as in all image plots of the package (character): "quantile" (histogram-equalised), "log", "sqrt", "linear" or "auto" (logarithmic for mostly empty maps or values spanning more than three orders of magnitude, quantiles otherwise); see plot_wavelet. Not used for style = "significance", which has a fixed diverging scale. Default="auto".

Value

Invisibly, the matrix shown.
